manifest.note: Values are pre-computed. null means not reported and is never zero. basis='historical' marks the ICPPA 2026 baseline (country presentations, June 2026), not a validated quarterly return. held=1 marks a figure held by an open High query; it is excluded from every regional total. Cells under 5 are suppressed, not merely flagged.

dim.label_en: PEN-Plus integrated into national NCD strategy and UHC agenda
dim.definition: Countries with the milestone achieved and a document named
dim.formula: countries with status yes and a document title, over countries reporting

dim.label_en: PEN-Plus Plan developed, approved, launched and under implementation
dim.definition: Countries with the milestone achieved and a document named
dim.formula: countries with status yes and a document title, over countries reporting

dim.label_en: Costed National Operational Plan on PEN-Plus developed and launched
dim.definition: Countries with the milestone achieved and a document named
dim.formula: countries with status yes and a document title, over countries reporting

dim.label_en: National guidelines and protocols disseminated to all PEN-Plus sites
dim.definition: Priority conditions with an adapted, validated protocol disseminated to every site
dim.formula: count of priority conditions marked disseminated, over how many were reported

dim.definition: Facilities assessed with the AFRO readiness tool during the year
dim.formula: count of facilities with a readiness class

dim.definition: Facilities capacitated and offering PEN-Plus services
dim.formula: count of facilities with status operational or started_this_period

dim.definition: Facilities scoring at least 80 per cent with all critical criteria met
dim.formula: numerator over facilities assessed against the checklist

dim.label_en: PEN-Plus patients ever enrolled, all conditions
dim.definition: All PEN-Plus patients ever enrolled: T1D, SCD, RHD and the other conditions the country manages in PEN-Plus clinics
dim.formula: the country's all-conditions total; never rebuilt from condition columns

dim.label_en: Sentinel patients ever enrolled (T1D, SCD, RHD)
dim.definition: Patients ever enrolled with a sentinel condition: type 1 diabetes, sickle cell disease, rheumatic heart disease
dim.formula: sum of ever_enrolled over T1D, SCD and RHD (severe hypertension excluded)

dim.definition: Sentinel-condition patients active in care at the end of the period
dim.formula: sum of active in care over T1D, SCD and RHD (reported alongside 2.6)

dim.label_en: Approximate retention (excludes patients enrolled this quarter)
dim.definition: Sentinel patients still in care, among those enrolled before this quarter
dim.formula: (active in care - newly enrolled) / (ever enrolled - newly enrolled), computed by the pipeline; the country-entered retention % is never read

dim.label_en: People completing a PEN-Plus WHO Academy course
dim.definition: Cumulative course completions, pre-filled by WHO AFRO from the Academy system
dim.formula: sum of female, male and not-stated completions

dim.label_en: Health workers trained as Trainers of Trainers
dim.definition: Providers qualified to train others, cumulative by cadre
dim.formula: sum of female, male and not-stated ToT trained, cumulative

dim.definition: Providers trained at facility level this quarter, by cadre
dim.formula: sum of female, male and not-stated trained this quarter

dim.label_en: Facilities with an active clinical mentorship programme
dim.definition: Facilities with at least one documented mentorship visit in the quarter
dim.formula: facilities with a mentorship visit this quarter over operational facilities

dim.definition: Countries that held a round table to mobilize resources for PEN-Plus this year
dim.formula: countries with round table held = yes, over countries reporting

dim.label_en: PEN-Plus indicators integrated into national HMIS / DHIS2
dim.definition: Countries answering Yes: PEN-Plus indicators configured in the national HMIS / DHIS2
dim.formula: countries answering Yes (Partial is shown, not counted)

dim.definition: Consent-safeguarded products published in the year
dim.formula: sum of product counts across product types
